content.title: Coachella 2026 Weekend 1 Set Times & How to Stream: Full Schedule | Beatportal
content.text: Set times are here for Weekend 1 of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, running April 10–12. The sold-out 25th-anniversary edition brings a slate of dance/electronic talent to Indio, with the genre accounting for 45% of this year's lineup, according to an analysis from Booking Agent Info. This includes highly-anticipated sets from Anyma, who will present the world debut of his new audiovisual concept, ÆDEN, at the Coachella Stage on April 10, Fatboy Slim, Tiga, WORSHIP, Prospa, Kaskade, and more. Coachella will stream performances from seven stages simultaneously (up from six last year) via its YouTube channel, including the Coachella Stage, Outdoor Theatre, Sahara, Quasar (vertical and horizontal), Mojave, Gobi, and Sonora. The Yuma tent will exclusively stream during Weekend 2. This year, three stages – Coachella, Outdoor Theatre, and Sahara – will be streamed in 4K for the first time. The livestream begins at 4 p.m. on April 10. In addition to live performances, Couchella viewers can tune in to Coachella TV, a nonstop stream broadcasting “classic performances, documentaries, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage from the festival’s 25-year history,” with 2026 highlights to follow. While tickets to the 2026 festival are sold out, resale passes are available here.View the full Weekend 1 schedule below, and stay tuned for Weekend 2 set times.
